dialogues.en:
The night is filled with rows of cherry trees as far as the
eye can see.
dialogues.text:
The night is filled with rows of cherry trees as far as the
eye can see.

dialogues.jp: ｛しんしん／深々｝と桜が舞っている。
dialogues.en: The moon is round, floating high in the sky.
dialogues.text: The moon is round, floating high in the sky.

dialogues.jp: 驚くほどゆったりと。
dialogues.en: "Sakura... No, it's not?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura... No, it's not?"

dialogues.jp: 音もなく。
dialogues.en: I shake my head slowly at the Sakura-alike in front of me.
dialogues.text: I shake my head slowly at the Sakura-alike in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
天使の羽のような花びらの散りざまは、まるで
永遠を思わせる一瞬。
dialogues.en: "You."
dialogues.text: "You."

dialogues.en: You are the one who's been watching me.
dialogues.text: You are the one who's been watching me.

dialogues.jp: ふと、奇妙な懐かしさと、違和感に襲われる。
dialogues.en: "Grandma."
dialogues.text: "Grandma."

dialogues.jp: （……桜が咲いている？）
dialogues.en: "That's not quite right, but it's kind of correct."
dialogues.text: "That's not quite right, but it's kind of correct."

dialogues.jp:
雪のように積もった桜をざくざく、と踏みしめ
ながら、ぼりぼりと頭をかく。
dialogues.en: The witch smiles, not completely denying what I said.
dialogues.text: The witch smiles, not completely denying what I said.

dialogues.en:
"I am your conscious mind. I am the thought left in this
cherry tree."
dialogues.text:
"I am your conscious mind. I am the thought left in this
cherry tree."

dialogues.jp:
周囲を見渡しても遠近感がぼやけていて、終わ
りというものがない世界。
dialogues.en:
"I could say I'm 'Dream', or 'Cherry blossoms that never
die'."
dialogues.text:
"I could say I'm 'Dream', or 'Cherry blossoms that never
die'."

dialogues.jp: 狂ったように桜だけが舞っている。

dialogues.en: The thing walks over, stepping on the pile of cherry petals.
dialogues.text: The thing walks over, stepping on the pile of cherry petals.

dialogues.jp: フラフラと文字通り夢見ごこちで歩が進む。
dialogues.en:
As she walks gracefully, the cherry petals shatter like thin
ice.
dialogues.text:
As she walks gracefully, the cherry petals shatter like thin
ice.

dialogues.jp: 導かれるように。
dialogues.en: The thing stretches out her hand to my motionless chest.
dialogues.text: The thing stretches out her hand to my motionless chest.

dialogues.jp: あまりにも非現実的な景色に鳥肌が立つ。
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, you'll be all right. Hahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, you'll be all right. Hahahaha..."

dialogues.jp:
舞い散る桜に｛いざな／誘｝われるように、ひとりの少女が
立っていた。
dialogues.en: The thing hits my chest forcefully.
dialogues.text: The thing hits my chest forcefully.

dialogues.jp: ――その少女は、天使でなければ悪魔であろう。
dialogues.en: I feel dizzy. I don't think she's a ghost any more.
dialogues.text: I feel dizzy. I don't think she's a ghost any more.

dialogues.jp: 「魔法使い」
dialogues.en: "You are..."
dialogues.text: "You are..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「おはよう……夢の世界へようこそ……うんん。
　もう目覚めたんだね」
dialogues.en: "Who said I should remain cool all the time?"
dialogues.text: "Who said I should remain cool all the time?"

dialogues.jp:
狂ったように桜が散り、舞い、跳ね、朽ち、そ
の養分を吸いとって咲き、また散る世界。
dialogues.en: "That may be true, but the air is..."
dialogues.text: "That may be true, but the air is..."

dialogues.jp: 果てまでも桜の木が埋め尽くす夜。
dialogues.en: "Fine, fine... You sound like Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Fine, fine... You sound like Nemu."

dialogues.jp: 月は丸く高く浮く。
dialogues.en: The thing walks back to the tree and laughs.
dialogues.text: The thing walks back to the tree and laughs.

dialogues.jp: 「……さくら……いや、違うか」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I thought about seeing Sakura, but instead, I came to
see you for the last farewell."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I thought about seeing Sakura, but instead, I came to
see you for the last farewell."

dialogues.jp:
目の前にいるさくらの姿をした｛・・／ソレ｝に、ゆっく
りと首を振る。
「あんたか」
dialogues.en: "Are you going to disappear?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going to disappear?"

dialogues.jp: ずっと見守っていたのは、あなただったのか。
dialogues.en: "Yes. They died, didn't they?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. They died, didn't they?"

dialogues.jp: 「ばあちゃん」
dialogues.en:
The thing nods, speaking very lightly as if only talking
about today's dinner.
dialogues.text:
The thing nods, speaking very lightly as if only talking
about today's dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「少し違うけど……まぁ、そうだね」
dialogues.en: "You have to reap what you sow... I mean plant."
dialogues.text: "You have to reap what you sow... I mean plant."

dialogues.jp: 否定はせず、魔法使いが微笑む。

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「私は残留思念に近い存在だよ。この桜に残っ
　た想いの形」
dialogues.en: "I hoped it would be helpful for other people."
dialogues.text: "I hoped it would be helpful for other people."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「“夢”もしくは“枯れない桜”そのものと言っ
　たほうが近い存在だけどね」
dialogues.en:
"It's very difficult to live in this world. You can't really
talk about your dreams, and making a dream come true is
almost a miracle."
dialogues.text:
"It's very difficult to live in this world. You can't really
talk about your dreams, and making a dream come true is
almost a miracle."

dialogues.jp:
ざくざく、と花びらを華麗に踏みしめながら、
ソレが歩み寄る。
dialogues.en:
The thing discusses the subtlety of the human mind while
looking away.
dialogues.text:
The thing discusses the subtlety of the human mind while
looking away.

dialogues.jp:
それは舞うような足取りで、｛はくひょう／薄氷｝のように花び
らが弾ける。
dialogues.en:
"They want to get away from normality. They don't like
ordinariness. They don't want to work. This world is boring,
no fun..."
dialogues.text:
"They want to get away from normality. They don't like
ordinariness. They don't want to work. This world is boring,
no fun..."

dialogues.jp:
と、どうしてか身じろぎひとつ出来ない俺の胸
に向かってソレが手を伸ばした。

dialogues.en: That sounds like everybody's complaints, for sure.
dialogues.text: That sounds like everybody's complaints, for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「ま、実際んなこと言ったって、別になんでも
　ないから大丈夫だってわさ♪　あはははは！」
dialogues.en:
"I can show you what a real dream is, where the flowers
would never die, a miracle would happen, and you would see
somebody who has super-powers."
dialogues.text:
"I can show you what a real dream is, where the flowers
would never die, a miracle would happen, and you would see
somebody who has super-powers."

dialogues.jp: ぱしぱし、と気前良く胸を叩かれる。
dialogues.en:
"I was hoping to create a world where the sympathy toward
humanity would produce a power."
dialogues.text:
"I was hoping to create a world where the sympathy toward
humanity would produce a power."

dialogues.jp:
｛めまい／眩暈｝がする……神秘的さなんて、一発で吹き飛
んだ。
dialogues.en:
"That's what Hatsune Island is about... Cherry blossoms that
never die."
dialogues.text:
"That's what Hatsune Island is about... Cherry blossoms that
never die."

dialogues.jp: 「あんたはなぁ……」
dialogues.en: The thing chuckles.
dialogues.text: The thing chuckles.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「なによ、こういう存在が澄ました顔してなきゃ
　いけないなんて法律、どこにもないわよ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, the cherry blossoms that never die are produced by
magic power."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, the cherry blossoms that never die are produced by
magic power."

dialogues.jp: 木まで戻ってソレが笑う。
dialogues.en: Talking about things I don't understand, the thing smiles.
dialogues.text: Talking about things I don't understand, the thing smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「いやさ、さくらに会おうかとも思ったんだけ
　ど、最後の挨拶はお前にしておこうと思って
　さ」
dialogues.en:
"The magic system collects people's dreams --that is,
unconscious hopes-- through flower petals and pollen, and
gives them back to people who need them."
dialogues.text:
"The magic system collects people's dreams --that is,
unconscious hopes-- through flower petals and pollen, and
gives them back to people who need them."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en:
"Your dreams will come true if you keep wishing. You get
answered if you pray. Everyone could be happy with kindness
from everybody, rather than just on an individual basis."
dialogues.text:
"Your dreams will come true if you keep wishing. You get
answered if you pray. Everyone could be happy with kindness
from everybody, rather than just on an individual basis."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……消えるのか？」
dialogues.en:
The thing laughs, spreading its hands, and putting them down
as the petals fall.
dialogues.text:
The thing laughs, spreading its hands, and putting them down
as the petals fall.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ。枯れたじゃん」
dialogues.en:
"Well, the reason I came up with this is because of my
granddaughter, who had a hard time because of bullies."
dialogues.text:
"Well, the reason I came up with this is because of my
granddaughter, who had a hard time because of bullies."

dialogues.jp:
今日の夕食をどうしようか？　と言った軽い口
調でソレが｛うなず／頷｝く。
dialogues.en: "Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「自分で｛ま／蒔｝いた……植えた木は、自分で枯らさ
　なきゃ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, do you know Peter Pan? That's Sakura's favorite
story."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, do you know Peter Pan? That's Sakura's favorite
story."

dialogues.jp: 人の心の｛きび／機微｝をソレが遠い目で語る。
dialogues.en: "What? Yeah."
dialogues.text: "What? Yeah."

dialogues.jp: それは確かに、誰もが思うような｛ぐち／愚痴｝だ。
dialogues.en: But I don't want her to stay as a child forever...
dialogues.text: But I don't want her to stay as a child forever...

dialogues.jp: くすくす、とソレが｛ほほえ／微笑｝む。
dialogues.en:
The story is about a boy named Peter Pan, who can fly in the
sky, and it is based on the world called Neverland.
dialogues.text:
The story is about a boy named Peter Pan, who can fly in the
sky, and it is based on the world called Neverland.

dialogues.jp: なんだか分からないことでソレが笑う。
dialogues.en: I don't know what the point is.
dialogues.text: I don't know what the point is.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「桜の花びらや花粉を通して人の夢――無意
　識に見る願いを集めて、困ってる人に集め
　る｛システム／魔法｝」
dialogues.en:
"I know it's not relevant, but when I saw you for the first
time, I thought you were like Peter Pan."
dialogues.text:
"I know it's not relevant, but when I saw you for the first
time, I thought you were like Peter Pan."

dialogues.jp:
手を広げて笑いながら、桜がはらはらと散るよ
うにその手も落ちる。
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、こういうことを考えたのも、ワタシの
　孫がいじめられたことにも関係しているのだ
　ろうけどね」
dialogues.en:
"You don't like hassle, you're selfish, and hate boring
stuff, but you'll always give a helping hand even if you
complain."
dialogues.text:
"You don't like hassle, you're selfish, and hate boring
stuff, but you'll always give a helping hand even if you
complain."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「さくら」
dialogues.en:
"You took over my magic power to create sweets for people
who're sad, without asking for a bigger power."
dialogues.text:
"You took over my magic power to create sweets for people
who're sad, without asking for a bigger power."

dialogues.jp: いつまでも子供のままでいられたら……。
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean? I just don't want to be bothered, that's
all."
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean? I just don't want to be bothered, that's
all."

dialogues.jp:
それを現実のものとした、ネバーランドという
世界を舞台にした、空を飛べるピーターパンと
いう少年の物語。
dialogues.en: I look away.
dialogues.text: I look away.

dialogues.jp: それがなんなのだろう。
dialogues.en: The thing twists her mouth while circling the tree.
dialogues.text: The thing twists her mouth while circling the tree.

dialogues.jp: ぷい、と横を向く。
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「いや、お前は空を飛べなくても、色々なモノ
　に立ち向かっていった……全てのきっかけに
　なる者は必ず必要だってことだわさ」
dialogues.en: "Yep. No special meaning. That's all."
dialogues.text: "Yep. No special meaning. That's all."

dialogues.jp:
木の周りをぐるぐる、と回りながらナニカが唇
を歪める。
dialogues.en: "Well, is it anything to do with Peter Pan?"
dialogues.text: "Well, is it anything to do with Peter Pan?"

dialogues.en: "Setting... Neverland, the island of dreams."
dialogues.text: "Setting... Neverland, the island of dreams."

dialogues.jp: あれ？
dialogues.en: What?
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.jp: 「夢の島？」
dialogues.en: "Island of dreams?"
dialogues.text: "Island of dreams?"

dialogues.jp:
東京のゴミ捨て場ではなく、まさに文字通りの
意味に首をひねる。
dialogues.en:
It's exactly what it means, not a dump yard in Tokyo. My
mind churns, thinking of the meaning of the phrase.
dialogues.text:
It's exactly what it means, not a dump yard in Tokyo. My
mind churns, thinking of the meaning of the phrase.

dialogues.jp: 「桜が枯れない不思議な島……」
dialogues.en:
"It's a strange island where the cherry blossoms would never
die."
dialogues.text:
"It's a strange island where the cherry blossoms would never
die."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「そう、そして最後には……みんな、巣立って
　いく」
dialogues.en: "And eventually, everybody leaves for their own future."
dialogues.text: "And eventually, everybody leaves for their own future."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「……夢は覚めるものだから」
dialogues.en: "You will wake up from a dream eventually."
dialogues.text: "You will wake up from a dream eventually."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「それに、こんな世界を作り上げて、みんなを
　苦しめた責任はとらないとね」
dialogues.en:
"And I have to take responsibility, for the fact that I
created this world and gave people hard times."
dialogues.text:
"And I have to take responsibility, for the fact that I
created this world and gave people hard times."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「無差別に勝手に夢を叶えるなんてのは、余計
　なお節介だったよ……これがホントの年寄り
　の冷や水ってか？」
dialogues.en:
"It was meddlesome that I made their dreams come true, and
this is a perfect example of being careful what you wish
for."
dialogues.text:
"It was meddlesome that I made their dreams come true, and
this is a perfect example of being careful what you wish
for."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「あんたのせいじゃないだろ？」
dialogues.en: "That wasn't your fault, wasn't it?"
dialogues.text: "That wasn't your fault, wasn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「うん？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……望んだのは俺達じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "We asked for it."
dialogues.text: "We asked for it."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「俺達はどっかで考えてるよ……普通は嫌だっ
　て」
dialogues.en: "We always think of getting away from the routine."
dialogues.text: "We always think of getting away from the routine."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……心の底から願ってた」
dialogues.en: "I disliked it from the bottom of my heart."
dialogues.text: "I disliked it from the bottom of my heart."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「普通は嫌だって……」
dialogues.en: "I hated the routine."
dialogues.text: "I hated the routine."

dialogues.jp:
ひとりひとりの力を集めるというのなら、この
世界の責任をとるべきなのは俺達だろう。
dialogues.en:
If we ought to put everybody's hope together, I think that's
enough responsibility for this world.
dialogues.text:
If we ought to put everybody's hope together, I think that's
enough responsibility for this world.

dialogues.jp:
学生にそういう力を持っている者が多いのも、
それが理由かも知れない……。
dialogues.en: It could be the reason why many students are good at that.
dialogues.text: It could be the reason why many students are good at that.

dialogues.jp:
「みんなの願いを叶えて、それが逆効果だからっ
　て、あんたが責任をとることないだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think you should take the blame because fulfilling
people's dreams turned out to backfire."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think you should take the blame because fulfilling
people's dreams turned out to backfire."

dialogues.jp:
「今のままならさ、孫の姿を見ていられるんだ
　ろう？　お前が願いを叶えるモノなら、桜を
　枯らさなくても良かったんだろう！？」
dialogues.en:
"You still can see your grandchild from where you are, can't
you? If you could've made everybody's dream come true, you
didn't need to make the cherry blossoms disappear, right?"
dialogues.text:
"You still can see your grandchild from where you are, can't
you? If you could've made everybody's dream come true, you
didn't need to make the cherry blossoms disappear, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「あんた……本気で言ってんの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you asking that seriously?"
dialogues.text: "Are you asking that seriously?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ……面倒だけど。あんただって生きてる
　んだ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... it's a hassle, but you're alive, like me."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... it's a hassle, but you're alive, like me."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.en: "Haha..."
dialogues.text: "Haha..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「あはははははははは――！」
dialogues.en: "Hahahahaha...!"
dialogues.text: "Hahahahaha...!"

dialogues.jp:
ソレが笑うと、風が吹いて桜が吹雪みたいに、
渦をまいた。
dialogues.en:
When the thing laughs, the wind blows, then the cherry
blossoms swirl like a snowstorm.
dialogues.text:
When the thing laughs, the wind blows, then the cherry
blossoms swirl like a snowstorm.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「いや、失敬失敬。まさか、ここまでバカだと
　は思わなかった」
dialogues.en: "Oops, sorry. I didn't know I was this stupid."
dialogues.text: "Oops, sorry. I didn't know I was this stupid."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "Buhh?!"
dialogues.text: "Buhh?!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「だから、いちいち音夢みたいな反応するなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't react stupidly like Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "Don't react stupidly like Nemu!"

dialogues.jp: 腹をさすってソレが頷く。
dialogues.en: The thing nods while stroking her stomach.
dialogues.text: The thing nods while stroking her stomach.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「いや、まぁ、いいんだ」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's okay."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's okay."

dialogues.jp: 大きくため息をついて、ソレが微笑む。
dialogues.en: It smiles after giving a sigh.
dialogues.text: It smiles after giving a sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ワタシは自転車の補助輪みたいなもんさ」
dialogues.en: "I'm kind of like a training wheel on a bicycle."
dialogues.text: "I'm kind of like a training wheel on a bicycle."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「最初はそれがないと走れない。ワタシは当た
　り前のように支えている」
dialogues.en:
"You can't ride a bike without those at first. But I am
always there."
dialogues.text:
"You can't ride a bike without those at first. But I am
always there."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「でも、いつかそれをはずさなきゃいけない時
　が来る……」
dialogues.en: "But sooner or later, you have to take them off."
dialogues.text: "But sooner or later, you have to take them off."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「最初は倒れる。苦労を覚える。たいていの人
　間はそこで痛みを知る」
dialogues.en:
"At first you fall over. You find it's not easy, and most
people get hurt at that point."
dialogues.text:
"At first you fall over. You find it's not easy, and most
people get hurt at that point."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「でも走れるようになる。いつか……補助輪が
　ないほうが速く走れることに気が付く。遠く
　まで行けることに気が付く」
dialogues.en:
"But one day, you find you can ride. And you notice you can
go not only faster but also a long way without a training
wheel."
dialogues.text:
"But one day, you find you can ride. And you notice you can
go not only faster but also a long way without a training
wheel."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「それが夢の終わり……現実のはじまり」
dialogues.en:
"That is the end of the dream, and yet the beginning of
reality."
dialogues.text:
"That is the end of the dream, and yet the beginning of
reality."

dialogues.jp: なぜか、少し寂しげにソレは笑う。
dialogues.en: For some reason, the thing smiles sadly.
dialogues.text: For some reason, the thing smiles sadly.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「今までは、あまりにも真っ直ぐで遠すぎた
　――永遠に続くと思っていた道の先まで行
　けるようになる」
dialogues.en:
"It was too far away for me at first, but I can go on and on
to further than I thought possible."
dialogues.text:
"It was too far away for me at first, but I can go on and on
to further than I thought possible."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp:
「お前はさ、皆が補助輪をはずすとき、そっと
　後ろから支えてやれたんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"When they took off the training wheel, you were there
holding it from behind."
dialogues.text:
"When they took off the training wheel, you were there
holding it from behind."

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp:
「そんなお前を見て、ワタシも……あぁ、これ
　でワタシはいなくても大丈夫だ、って思えた
　のさ」
dialogues.en:
"When I look at you, I realize I don't need to be here any
more."
dialogues.text:
"When I look at you, I realize I don't need to be here any
more."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「それが自転車の補助輪の役目なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "That is what a training wheel is for."
dialogues.text: "That is what a training wheel is for."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 静かに首を振る。
dialogues.en: She shakes her head gently.
dialogues.text: She shakes her head gently.

dialogues.jp: 「……それは俺達の台詞だ」
dialogues.en: "That's what we should say to you."
dialogues.text: "That's what we should say to you."

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「んにょ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Dream Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう。さよなら」
dialogues.en: "Thank you... and goodbye."
dialogues.text: "Thank you... and goodbye."

dialogues.jp: 静かに頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: I look down quietly.
dialogues.text: I look down quietly.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「ううん。挨拶が違うよ」
dialogues.en: "No, that's not the way you should say it."
dialogues.text: "No, that's not the way you should say it."

dialogues.jp: ざざざ、と桜の枝が鳴る。
dialogues.en: The cherry branches rustle.
dialogues.text: The cherry branches rustle.

dialogues.jp: 深々と桜が舞っている。
dialogues.en: Cherry petals are fluttering in the wind.
dialogues.text: Cherry petals are fluttering in the wind.

dialogues.jp: 驚くほどゆったりと。
dialogues.en: Very gently.
dialogues.text: Very gently.

dialogues.jp: 音もなく。
dialogues.en: Without a sound.
dialogues.text: Without a sound.

dialogues.jp:
天使の羽のような花びらの散りざまは、まるで
永遠を思わせる一瞬。
dialogues.en:
The way the flowers fall, like an angel's wing, makes me
think of eternity.
dialogues.text:
The way the flowers fall, like an angel's wing, makes me
think of eternity.

dialogues.jp: ソレと見詰め合ったまま息を殺す。
dialogues.en: I hold my breath while staring at the thing.
dialogues.text: I hold my breath while staring at the thing.

dialogues.jp:
むせ返るような匂いの桜が、足首までも飲み込
んでいた。
dialogues.en: The stifling scent of cherry blossoms fills the air.
dialogues.text: The stifling scent of cherry blossoms fills the air.

dialogues.speaker: Girl in the dream
dialogues.jp: 「また春に、会いましょう」
dialogues.en: "See you next spring."
dialogues.text: "See you next spring."

dialogues.jp: ソレが満面の笑みを浮かべる。
dialogues.en: The thing grins broadly.
dialogues.text: The thing grins broadly.

dialogues.jp: かすかに目の端に浮かんだ涙。
dialogues.en: I see tears at the corner of its eyes.
dialogues.text: I see tears at the corner of its eyes.

dialogues.jp: そして、消える――。
dialogues.en: And it disappears...
dialogues.text: And it disappears...

dialogues.jp: それは、そう……。
dialogues.en: That was then......
dialogues.text: That was then......

dialogues.jp: 春の終わりと、夏の訪れを迎える前の夢。
dialogues.en:
It was the dream that I had during springtime and before
summer.
dialogues.text:
It was the dream that I had during springtime and before
summer.

dialogues.jp:
この時点で意味をもった――ダ・カーポのよう
な、終わりとはじまりの夢。
dialogues.en:
Now, the phrase 'Da Capo' has a meaning... It's the ending
and yet the beginning of the dream.
dialogues.text:
Now, the phrase 'Da Capo' has a meaning... It's the ending
and yet the beginning of the dream.

dialogues.jp: また、いつか。
dialogues.en: Some day......
dialogues.text: Some day......

dialogues.jp:
夢で逢いましょう、と桜が笑った
春の出来事――。
dialogues.en:
It was in spring when Sakura said in a dream that we'll meet
again.
dialogues.text:
It was in spring when Sakura said in a dream that we'll meet
again.

dialogues.jp:
果てしなく続く、桜、桜、桜。今となっては懐
かしいこの景色。俺は導かれるように、夢の中、
一本の桜の木へと足を向けた。
dialogues.en: Cherry petals are fluttering in the wind.
dialogues.text: Cherry petals are fluttering in the wind.

dialogues.jp: ――ざく、ざく、ざく
dialogues.en: Very gently.
dialogues.text: Very gently.

dialogues.jp:
そこに、魔法使いは立っていた。さくらの姿を
した｛そいつ／魔法使い｝は、華麗に、｛いんぎん／慇懃｝に積もった桜の
花びらを踏みしめ、俺の前へと歩み寄った。
dialogues.en: Without a sound.
dialogues.text: Without a sound.

dialogues.jp:
さくら、いや……ばあちゃんか……。そう言う
と、俺はばしばしと気前よく胸を叩かれた。神
秘的に｛たたず／佇｝む少女の神秘性は、そこで失われた。
dialogues.en:
The way the flowers fall, like an angel's wing, makes me
think of eternity.
dialogues.text:
The way the flowers fall, like an angel's wing, makes me
think of eternity.

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんは、しかし、枯れない桜そのもの、
もしくはその残留思念だと名乗った。俺にはも
う、ばあちゃんとしか、思えなかったが。

そして、彼女は贖罪の言葉を口にした。淡々と
語る、それは初音島の、この｛・・・・／魔法の島｝の由来そ
のものだった。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, I feel a sense of both nostalgia and discomfort at
the same time.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, I feel a sense of both nostalgia and discomfort at
the same time.

dialogues.jp:
さくらのために、｛しんし／真摯｝な願いを持つもののため
に、少しずつ夢の力を島中から集めて、それを
必要としている人に還元する。
dialogues.en: (Cherry flowers in bloom?)
dialogues.text: (Cherry flowers in bloom?)

dialogues.jp:
枯れない桜は、真実魔法の産物で、魔法とは言
わばシステムなのだ、と。｛ここ／初音島｝は、｛ネバーランド／夢の島｝だ
ということを。
dialogues.en:
I scratch my head as I step upon the pile of cherry petals
like snow.
dialogues.text:
I scratch my head as I step upon the pile of cherry petals
like snow.

dialogues.jp:
だが、｛おわらない／覚めない｝夢は無い。夢の後に待っている
のは現実だ。そして、夢の終わりとは枯れない
桜が枯れるということだ。

だから、彼女は別れを言いに来たのだと云う。
どうして、最後の別れが俺なのか……。
dialogues.en:
This world has no ending. However much further you look, it
goes on forever.
dialogues.text:
This world has no ending. However much further you look, it
goes on forever.

dialogues.jp:
魔法は……自転車の補助輪なのだという。一人
で前へ進めるようになるまで、支えてくれる。
でも、いつか卒業しなくてはならないもの。
dialogues.en: The cherry petals are whirling madly in the air.
dialogues.text: The cherry petals are whirling madly in the air.

dialogues.jp:
彼女は、俺を見て、もうこの｛システム／魔法｝が必要ないと
思えたと言う。それは、俺は買いかぶりだと思
う。

別に俺はそんな大層なことをした覚えは無い。
だから俺は、彼女に素直に、ありがとう、さよ
うなら、と言った。
dialogues.en: I plod along as if I were in a dream.
dialogues.text: I plod along as if I were in a dream.

dialogues.jp:
彼女は不適に笑うと、挨拶が違う、と俺の言葉
を正した。
dialogues.en: Being guided.
dialogues.text: Being guided.

dialogues.jp: 「また春に、会いましょう」
それが彼女の、最後の言葉だった。
dialogues.en: This unreal sight makes me shiver.
dialogues.text: This unreal sight makes me shiver.

dialogues.jp: 春の終わりと、夏の始まりを伝える――
dialogues.en:
There's a girl standing right there, surrounded by
fluttering cherry petals.
dialogues.text:
There's a girl standing right there, surrounded by
fluttering cherry petals.

dialogues.jp: 夢の終わりと、現実の始まりを伝える――
dialogues.en: If she's not an angel, she's got to be the devil.
dialogues.text: If she's not an angel, she's got to be the devil.

dialogues.jp:
この時点で意味をもった――ダ・カーポのよう
な、終わりとはじまりの夢。
dialogues.en: "A witch."
dialogues.text: "A witch."

dialogues.jp: また、いつか。
dialogues.en:
"Good morning... Welcome to the world of dreams. You're up
now, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Good morning... Welcome to the world of dreams. You're up
now, huh?"

dialogues.jp:
夢で逢いましょう、と桜が笑った春の出来事
――。
dialogues.en:
The cherry flowers go mad, fly around, roll up, and die.
Then they get the nutrients from it to make flowers start to
bloom again, and fall down...
dialogues.text:
The cherry flowers go mad, fly around, roll up, and die.
Then they get the nutrients from it to make flowers start to
bloom again, and fall down...
